correctness.rationale: The proof classifies square roots mod odd prime powers, treats zero, nonunit and unit s separately, checks all boundary valuations and counts, derives E from squares of exact strata and two-parameter fourth moment by Fourier orthogonality. Standalone standard-library checker independently confirms all 437 s-rows across seven rings, 27,540 ordered pairs, two direct complex fourth moments. Finite computations are corroboration only; all quantifiers are proved.

originality.rationale: Primary published full texts and actual indexed mathematical searches did not state the complete ordered two-point vector-sum fiber census for the prime-power modular hyperbola. The closest coordinate-sumset work projects ONE hyperbola point onto x+y, and one-variable Kloosterman fourth-moment theorems do not recover the full two-coordinate valuation-stratified representation function. Related statements concern modular restricted-character orthogonality and finite-field sharp extension, neither of which covers this ring-level object. Priority is not certified: two plausible Zhang full texts remain unavailable and a classical equivalent formulation could exist.

value.rationale: The full positive-fiber census is a canonical complete additive invariant for modular hyperbolas over all odd prime-power rings, not a selected arbitrary numeric parameter. It exposes every nilpotent valuation layer and the one exceptional discriminant-zero fiber and yields an exact normalized two-parameter Fourier fourth moment growing linearly with prime-power exponent. This directly answers a natural convolution question and improves quantitative knowledge of modular hyperbola Fourier moments beyond bounds or one-variable averaging. It does not require a downstream theorem or claim sharp arbitrary-input extension.
